title: Autonomous Popup Payload Synthesizer & Execution Verifier
summary: AI mengeksekusi popup synthesizer selama 180 detik (120 probing). Ditemukan 0 konfirmasi popup.

mitigations: 1. Implement strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers with nonce/hash to block inline script and popup execution.
2. Enforce rigorous output HTML-encoding and sanitization (DOMPurify) on live reflected parameters.
3. Enforce HttpOnly and Secure flags on all active cookies.
4. Deploy WAF rules blocking popup-triggering functions.
